title: One bracket too many
prompt: There is an extra closing bracket on the print line. Remove it so the robot prints "Done".
hints: Brackets must come in matching pairs.
Count the ( and ) on the print line.
Delete one of the two closing brackets.

docs.name: The error panel
docs.what: Godot's message plus the line it happened on, counted from the top of your code.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
